title: Event log summary
pitch: Turn a day of System and Application events into one screen: the hourly trend, who is noisy, which IDs repeat and what was critical.
makeItYours: Fill the counts from Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable with Level 1 to 3 and StartTime set to 24 hours ago, grouped by hour, ProviderName and Id.
Add your own meaning for the event IDs you see every week, so the table explains them.
Run it per server or per role and keep the busiest hour beside your change calendar.
useCase: Use it when the morning check has to answer what happened overnight before anyone opens Event Viewer.
